searchText: I just tested the faucet and it worked fine for me, mind sharing what was broken? Btw you can also use `panda` cli to claim funds on devnet-8 just tell your ai to use panda cli, create a eoa and fund it It was saying the RPC was down. Maybe due to some attacks. ah okay, yeah probably one of the RPC nodes that was used via the erpc proxy was having issues overview of the weekend attacks the first is jochems jumptest then its pawels attacks or wait this is 26th september saturday? then its all pawels attacks Lovely. Do you have any data on builders? are you looking for anything specific? like a builder submitting invalid payloads? Are you interested in which builder is including your transactions or when they reveal the payload? Rather builder timings as they cannot execute in parallel (or I try to prevent them executing in parallel so I'm interested if I succeeded) Post-Gloas Prysm gossip DoS thread on `nimbus-reth-1` and `nimbus-reth-2` on `devnet-8`, <@&1070471163219824730> is consistently not providing a payload: ``` INFO[2026-09-28T11:14:12Z] REQUEST #1323573: POST / length=90 method=engine_getPayloadV6 type=json { "id": 1024, "jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "engine_getPayloadV6", "params": [ "0x0ef00097ae4e2b4c" ] } ERRO[2026-09-28T11:14:13Z] call failed: proxy request error: Post "http://execution:8551/": context canceled ``` https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-8.ethpandaops.io/slot/331715#arrival is this from the jumpdest txs? or are you trying something else? yes, jumpdest of deployed 64kb codes. It seems slow when executed sporadically when the code caches are empty can we give Marko (https://github.com/markolazic01) access to the lodestar nodes please
